column1: # mapping_set_title: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 to ISO/IEC 23894:2023 Schema Mappings

# mapping_set_description: Schema-level mappings between the ISO/IEC 42001:2023 (AI Management System) and ISO/IEC 23894:2023 (Guidance on risk management for AI) LinkML schemas. ISO/IEC 23894 provides the canonical guidance on AI-specific risk management processes referenced by ISO/IEC 42001 clause 6.1.

column10: Both standards adopt the ISO 31000 / ISO Guide 73 definition of risk applied to the AI context.
ISO/IEC 42001 clause 6.1.2 references the ISO/IEC 23894 risk management process for AI risk identification, analysis, and evaluation.
Both standards model the same risk treatment process (option selection, control implementation, residual risk acceptance) applied to AI risks.
ISO/IEC 23894 introduces the AI system impact assessment process that is formalised as a normative requirement in ISO/IEC 42001 clause 6.1.4.
